name: HypeAgent by HypeAuditor
description:
HypeAgent is the official MCP server from HypeAuditor, the influencer marketing analytics platform trusted to vet and discover creators across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok. It brings HypeAuditor's creator database and audience-quality analytics directly into Claude.

Key features:
• Creator discovery — search HypeAuditor's influencer database by platform, category, interests, audience demographics, location, follower count, and engagement rate.
• Account analytics — pull detailed HypeAuditor reports for any Instagram, YouTube, or TikTok account, including Audience Quality Score, engagement rate, growth trends, and audience demographics.
• Fraud and audience quality checks — surface fake followers, suspicious engagement, and bot activity using HypeAuditor's fraud detection.
• Side-by-side comparison — evaluate up to 100 creators against your own criteria to shortlist the best fit for a campaign.
• Content search — find posts, videos, and sponsored content across platforms with advanced filtering.
• Targeted insights — ask specific questions about an account without pulling a full report.

All tools are read-only. Requires a HypeAgent account (hypeagent.io); connect via OAuth.

_published_faq.name: How do I add HypeAgent by HypeAuditor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add HypeAgent by HypeAuditor to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.hypeagent.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the HypeAgent by HypeAuditor MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: HypeAgent by HypeAuditor provides these MCP tools: hypeauditor-analyze-accounts, hypeauditor-compare-accounts, hypeauditor-content-search, hypeauditor-discovery-settings, hypeauditor-get-account-insights, hypeauditor-get-account-social-ids, and hypeauditor-search-influencers.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to HypeAgent by HypeAuditor?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to HypeAgent by HypeAuditor in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does HypeAgent by HypeAuditor MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: HypeAgent by HypeAuditor requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
HypeAgent by HypeAuditor is developed by HypeAuditor. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
